title: Fiscal Review, Compliance, and Audit
before:
The Department of Education Fiscal Review and Compliance Team is responsible for developing and coordinating fiscal compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements through Department guidance and sub-recipient monitoring; tracks and interprets laws and regulations that might affect the Department and/or sub-recipients and implements necessary changes; reviews Major Capital School Construction Projects for final fiscal compliance and determines final expenditures and revenues, state/local share and local share of unused bond proceeds and net interest income; and coordinates external state and federal audit reviews, findings, and resolutions.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 1 link on this page opens a file — 1 PowerPoint — and says nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Draw a closing link as the action it is
decisions.why: 1 passage ends with a paragraph holding nothing but a link — the thing the passage was leading up to. Set as running text it looks like any other link in the sentence above it. The site already has one way of drawing an action, so it takes that. The words do not change.

decisions.label: Run a label into the line it labels
decisions.why: 1 label sits alone in a paragraph with the sentence it labels in the next one — two blocks, two margins and a line break to say one thing. Down a list of exclusions that reads as a column of orphaned labels. Run in with a colon, which is how a term and its definition are set. The only character added is the colon.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: The Department of Education Fiscal Review and Compliance Team is responsible for developing and coordinating fiscal compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements through Department guidance and sub-recipient monitoring; tracks and interprets laws and regulations that might affect the Department and/or sub-recipients and implements necessary changes; reviews Major Capital School Construction Projects for final fiscal compliance and determines final expenditures and revenues, state/local share and local share of unused bond proceeds and net interest income; and coordinates external state and federal audit reviews, findings, and resolutions.

decisions.label: Let a bold line dividing a card be its heading
decisions.why: 1 line inside a card is a paragraph holding nothing but a few bold words — "Records Management" is one — with the part of the card it names underneath. That is a heading, and set as a paragraph it carries no level, so the card offers nothing to scan by and a screen reader announces only running text. Each becomes an h3 and takes the same section bar the other card headings use. Only where a card has two or more, which is what makes them divisions rather than one stressed line. Not a word changes.
